The account, despite being KYC/KYB verified, exhibits strong indicators of fraudulent activity, specifically card testing. The flag reason 'VELOCITY_SPIKE' is directly supported by a rapid burst of 28 low-value card authorization attempts within a minute and a half on 2026-06-10, with 25 of these transactions being declined and involving numerous different card numbers (instrument_last4 and BINs). This pattern is characteristic of attempts to validate stolen card information. While the owner provided a note claiming to be 'testing payment integration,' the volume, speed, and high decline rate across diverse cards are inconsistent with legitimate integration testing. The MCC 5817 (Digital Goods) is also often associated with higher fraud risk. The combination of card testing, suspicious login location, and a new account (9 days tenure) warrants immediate rejection to prevent further fraudulent activity.
